n-k-k3-01.title: Vhiki yekupera kumba here?
n-k-k3-01.goal: Enzanisa chirevo chakasimba cheshamwari yekirasi nedhayari pfupi, sarudza izwi renguva dzinoitika rinotsigirwa nehumbowo, uye tsanangura kuti nei 'always' yakawandisa.
n-k-k3-01.material:
Shamwari yekirasi inoti: "세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요." Unoverenga dhayari yevhiki yekupera ya세진 yemavhiki mana:

1주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
1주 일요일: 집에서 책을 읽었어요.
2주 토요일: 친구랑 극장에서 영화를 봤어요.
2주 일요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
3주 토요일: 집에서 게임을 했어요.
3주 일요일: 집에서 청소를 했어요.
4주 토요일: 집에서 쉬었어요.
4주 일요일: 공원에서 자전거를 탔어요.
n-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Unoziva 항상 (nguva dzose) ne 아니에요 (haisi); mamwe mazwi enguva dzinoitika (보통, 가끔, 거의) anotsanangurwa mumazano nemutsananguro
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara upi pamusoro pa세진 unotsigirwa zvakanakisa nedhayari yose?
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti mazuva mangani muna 8 evhiki yekupera akapedzerwa kumba uye mangani asina.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba dzako mbiri nemazwi: 항상 = nguva dzose, 보통 = kazhinji, 가끔 = dzimwe nguva, 거의 없어요 = kashoma chaizvo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Mazuva maviri pamusere akapedzerwa kunze (cinema nepaki), saka 'always' inopfuura zvinotaurwa nedhayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.b: Mazuva matanhatu pamusere aiva kumba, saka 'never at home' ndizvo zvakapesana nezvinoratidzwa nedhayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: '가끔' zvinoreva dzimwe nguva chete. Dhayari inoratidza kumba kazhinji, izvo zvinopfuura 'sometimes'.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.e: '거의 없어요' zvinoreva kuti haakumbi kumba, izvo zvakapesana nemazuva matanhatu pamusere ari kumba.
n-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Verenga mazuva: 6 pamazuva 8 evhiki yekupera aiva kumba, 2 asina. Izwi re 'kazhinji' (보통) rinokodzera; izwi re 'nguva dzose' (항상) rakasimba zvakanyanya, uye 'sometimes' kana 'hardly ever' rakaderera zvakanyanya.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yako yekirasi inoti '세진은 주말에 항상 집에 있어요.' Zvinyorwa zvipi zvedhayari zvinoratidza kuti chirevo ichi hachisi chechokwadi? Sarudza zvose zvinoshanda.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Chirevo chinotaura nezvezuva rimwe nerimwe revhiki yekupera. Zuva rakaita sei rinoiputsa: rinokodzera chirevo here kana kuti harina?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pazvinyorwa zvimwe nezvimwe, tonga: zvinokodzera chirevo kana kuziputsa here?
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Zuva iri raiva kumba, saka rinobvumirana nechirevo. Haringaratidzi kuti chirevo chakanganisa.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.c: Zuva iri raivawo kumba, saka rinobvumirana nechirevo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Chirevo che 'always' chinoputswa nezuva rimwe chete risingakodzeri. Mazuva ekumba anongobvumirana nechirevo; haagoni kuchisimbisa nokuti chirevo chinotaura nezvezuva rimwe nerimwe.
n-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa wakakwana kuputsa '항상'; wechipiri, 4주 일요일, unoratidza kuti hazvina kuitika kamwe chete.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Pindura shamwari yako yekirasi muKorean (kutaura kwe -요 kune hunhu). Taura kuti '항상' haina kururama, uye ipa zuva rimwe kubva padhayari sehumbowo.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nechikamu chinoti 'not always', wobva wawedzera chinyorwa chimwe chedhayari.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Taura kuti 세진 aiva kupi pazuva iroro, uchishandisa -에서.
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura zuva kana nzvimbo imwe chaiyo yedhayari here?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Mhinduro yangu inofadza uye haina kuoma here?
n-k-k3-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inotaura izwi rakanakisa uye inopa humbowo.

n-k-k3-02.title: Chirongwa cha하나 nechiziviso cheraibhurari
n-k-k3-02.topic: Kukakavara kwenguva nenzvimbo pakati pechirongwa nechiziviso
n-k-k3-02.goal: Tarisa chirongwa chevhiki cheshamwari nechiziviso, tsvaga mutsetse mumwe unopikisa, taura rudzi rwekupikisana, uye gadzira chirongwa.
n-k-k3-02.material:
하나 anokutumira chirongwa chake chevhiki ino. Raibhurari yechikoro yakaisa chiziviso ichi:

[학교 도서관 안내]
- 문을 열어요: 화요일~일요일, 오전 9시~오후 6시
- 월요일은 쉬어요.
- 책은 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
n-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Unoziva mazuva evhiki ne 오전/오후 + nhamba + 시
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: Chirongwa cha하나 chevhiki ino hachienderani nechiziviso cheraibhurari mumutsetse mumwe. Sarudza mutsetse uyu.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mazuva nemaawa araibhurari yakavhurika, uchishandisa chiziviso chete.
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa mutsetse wese unotaura nezveraibhurari: zuva NEawa zvinoenderana nerondedzero yako here?
n-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 unotaura raibhurari musi we Monday, asi chiziviso chinoti raibhurari yakavharwa musi we Monday. Mutsetse 5 (Sunday, 5 p.m.) wakanaka nokuti raibhurari yakavhurika musi we Sunday kusvika pa6 p.m.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa zuva riri mumutsetse nechiziviso, wobva waenzanisa awa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Taura kuti ndeapi maviri (zuva, awa), kana ari akanganisa, haakodzeri chiziviso.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: 하나 anorongera kuenda raibhurari isati yavhura.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.a: Awa rekuvhura ndi9 a.m., saka 10 a.m. riri mukati memaawa ekuvhura; dambudziko riri pane imwe nyanzvi.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: 하나 anorongera kuenda pazuva umo chirongwa chake chinopikisa mumwe mutsetse.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: Hapana mumwe mutsetse wechirongwa chake uri pazuva iroro, saka hausi dambudziko.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: 하나 anorongera kuenda panguva yakapfuura kuvhara kweraibhurari.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Awa (10 a.m.) riri mukati memaawa ekuvhura; dambudziko riri pane imwe nyanzvi.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: 하나 anorongera kuenda pazuva raibhurari yakavharwa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Awa rakanaka, asi zuva rakavharwa rinoita kuti kushanya kwose kusagoneke. Kutarisa chirongwa nechiziviso kunoreva kutarisa nyanzvi yega yega (zuva, awa, nzvimbo), uye imwe chete yakakwana kuiputsa.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare mutsetse wakanganisa muKorean (kutaura kune hunhu) kuitira kuti chirongwa chishande. Chengeta chinangwa (kukwereta mabhuku), asi chinja zuva kana nguva.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza zuva kubva pamazuva ekuvhura echiziviso; wobva wasarudza awa riri pakati pekuvhura nekuvhara.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Chengeta pateni zuva + nguva: nzvimbo + chinhu + verb, sezvazvakaitwa mune mimwe mitsetse.
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zuva idzva iri zuva raibhurari yakavhurika here?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nguva yangu itsva inokodzera maawa ekuvhura (9 a.m. kusvika 6 p.m.) here?
n-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Zuva idzva rinopikisa mumwe mutsetse muchirongwa cha하나 here?

n-k-k3-03.title: Musangano wemuvhi une miganhu
n-k-k3-03.goal: Shandura meseji yeshamwari ine miganhu yakawanda (mazuva asipo, awa rekutanga, nguva yekupera yakatarwa) kuita zvirongwa zvakarurama, tsvaga zvinopfuura chimwe, uye utaure chimwe muKorean.
n-k-k3-03.material:
지호 anokutumira meseji:

"이번 주 평일에 같이 영화를 봐요! 월요일이랑 수요일에는 학원이 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 3시 이후에 시간이 있어요. 영화는 두 시간이에요. 오후 6시까지는 끝나야 해요."
n-k-k3-03.thinking.0: Mamiriro akavanzika: kureba kwemuvhi kunochinja nguva yekutanga
n-k-k3-03.prereq.1: Unoziva mazuva ebasa ne 오후 + nhamba + 시
n-k-k3-03.prereq.2: Wakasangana ne -까지 (kusvika, kusvikira), 이후 (mushure) ne 전에 (pamberi); atsanangurwa mumazano
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Muvhi inoita maawa 2 uye inofanira kupera pa6 p.m. Nguva yekutanga yekupedzisira inoshanda ndeipi?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tora 6 o'clock uye ubvise kureba kwemuvhi.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa mhinduro yako nokuwedzera maawa 2 kwairi. Mhedzisiro iri 6 kana kare here?
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.b: Iyo ndiyo nguva umo muvhi inofanira kunge yapera, kwete nguva yainogona kutanga.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.c: Kutanga pa5 p.m. kunoreva kuti muvhi inopera pa7 p.m., izvo zviri mushure me6.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 p.m. inoshanda, asi ndiyo nguva yekutanga yakabvumirwa neshamwari yako, kwete yekupedzisira.
n-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Kutanga + maawa 2 zvinofanira kuva 6 kana kare, saka kutanga ndi4 kwakanyanya. Pamwe ne 'after 3 p.m.' 3 ne4 chete ndizvo zvinogoneka.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga zvirongwa 3 zvinokodzera mamiriro ose mumeseji ya지호, imwe neimwe pazuva rakasiyana kana nguva yakasiyana. d = nhamba yezuva (월=1, 화=2, 수=3, 목=4, 금=5); h = awa rekutanga rimuvhi, masikati (3 zvinoreva 3 p.m.).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 이후 = mushure (kuverenga kubva) nguva iyoyo; -까지 = kusvikira / kusvika nguva iyoyo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora meseji nemazwi ako pachako semitemo yakaparadzana: mazuva api asipo, kubva pawa ripi, uye pawa ripi muvhi inofanira kupera.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Tanga nemazuva: bvisa 월 ne 수. Wobva waedza awa rimwe nerimwe rekutanga uye wowedzera 2.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.3: Kana chimwe chezvirongwa zvako chikaramba, verenga meseji iri pazasi petafura: inoti mutemo upi wakundikana.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Shandisa nhamba yezuva rakazara neawa rakazara.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 지호 anoda zuva rebasa, saka d iri 1 kusvika 5.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 지호 ane 학원 pa 월요일 (1) ne 수요일 (3).
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 지호 akasununguka kubva pa 3 p.m. chete.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Firimu remaawa 2 rinotanga nguva yakadaro rinopera shure kwe 6 p.m.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.explain: Mazuva anogona kuva 화, 목 kana 금, uye kutanga kunogona kuva 3 kana 4 p.m., saka pane hurongwa 6. Meseji inopa miganhu, kwete nguva imwe chaiyo.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza hurongwa HUMWE hwako uye utumire 지호 meseji pfupi muchiKorea (-요 ine rukudzo) ine zuva, nguva yekutanga nefirimu.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Shandisa hurongwa humwe huri pamusoro: zuva ripi neawa ripi?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Taura zuva, wobva wataura nguva, wobva wataura firimu, uye pedzisa ne -요.
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Zuva rangu neawa zvinoenderana nehurongwa humwe hwandakagadzira here?
n-k-k3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Mitemo ya지호 yaizochengetwa here dai akati hongu?

n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
n-k-k3-04.title: 민수 ari kuuya kupikiniki here?
n-k-k3-04.goal: Gadzirisa kutonga kwekuti shamwari yekirasi inouya here sezvo mameseji matsva achisvika, ona mazwi ekufungidzira, uye uzivise nhau nehuwandu hwakakodzera hwechokwadi.
n-k-k3-04.material: Uri kuunganidza mazita ekupikiniki yekirasi yeSatidha uye unoda kuziva kuti utenge chikafu chakadini. Unozvibvunza kuti 민수 anouya here. Mameseji anosvika rimwe nerimwe.
n-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Ndiani akazvitaura (kufungidzira kweshamwari kana munhu iye pachake)
n-k-k3-04.thinking.2: Kuchinja mhedziso kana ruzivo rutsva rwasvika
n-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Wakasangana ne 아마 (pamwe) ne -ㄹ 것 같아요 (zvinoita sekuti); zvinotsanangurwa mumazano
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga meseji imwe neimwe nenhevedzano, sarudza kuverenga kunoita sekwakanyanya, wobva waenderera.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cherekedza kuti ndiani ari kutaura mumeseji imwe neimwe, uye mazwi api anoita kuti mutsara uve wakapfava (아마, -ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 지아 ane chokwadi chakadini chekuti 민수 achauya paSatidha?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 아마 inoratidza kufungidzira. Panguva ino 'pamwe ari kuuya' ndiko kuverenga kunonzwisisika, kwete 'zvirokwazvo ari kuuya'.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: '아마' zvinoreva 'pamwe'. Mutauri ane chokwadi chizere haangaide.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hapana chiri mumutsara chinoti haazouyi; '올 거예요' inonongedzera mukuuya.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Anofunga kuti pamwe achauya, asi haana chokwadi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Anomutaura semunhu waanoziva; mutsara unotaura nezvekuti anouya here.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino 민수 iye pachake anotaura. Mufananidzo wacho unoita sei?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: -ㄹ 것 같아요 ne 아직 몰라요 zvinoratidza mubvunzo wakavhurika. Zvinotaurwa nemunhu iye pachake zvinokosha kupfuura kufungidzira kweshamwari.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hazvisati zvasarudzwa: anogona kuva nokuenda kuchipatara, saka pamwe haazokwanise kuuya.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Zvino munhu iye pachake anoti haana chokwadi, saka kufungidzira kwa지아 kuna nzvimbo shoma.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '갈 것 같아요' inotaura nezvokushanyira kunogoneka kwemune ramangwana, kwete chakaitika kare.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: '아직 몰라요' zvinoreva kuti haasati asarudza, saka haugone kuti haazouyi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ungataura chii zvino kana uchironga pikiniki?
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Meseji itsva inotsiva kufungidzira kwekare: kuuya zvino kwakajeka zvakanaka, nepo 'kunonoka zvishoma' kuchiri kufungidzira (-ㄹ 것 같아요).
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 민수 pamwe haagoni kuuya nokuda kwechipatara.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kushanyira chipatara kwapera kare (다녀왔어요), uye anoti anogona kuuya.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Anoti achanonoka zvishoma, saka haufanire kurongera panguva.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zvichiri zvisingagoneki kuziva kuti anouya here.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Zvino anoti zvakajeka kuti anogona kuenda paSatidha; mubvunzo wakavhurika wezuro wapindurwa.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 민수 anogona kuuya paSatidha, pamwe achinonoka zvishoma.
n-k-k3-04.s.s1.reflect: Pfungwa yako nezve 민수 yakachinja nemeseji imwe neimwe. Kufungidzira kweshamwari (아마) kwakatsiviwa nemazwi ake pachake asina chokwadi, uye wobva watsiviwa nemazwi ake akajeka. Mazwi akadai se 아마 ne -ㄹ 것 같아요 anoratidza kufungidzira, uye meseji itsva kubva kumunhu iye pachake ndiyo sosi yakanakisa.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Mazwi api kubva mumameseji matatu anoratidza kuti mutauri haana chokwadi chizere? Sarudza ese anoshanda.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bvunza pamutsara mumwe nemumwe: mutauri ari kuzivisa chakaitika here, kana kufungidzira nezvechinogona kuitika?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kutsiva mutsara ne 'for sure'. Mutsara unoramba uchinzwisisika here?
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.r.b: Uku kutaura kwakapfava kwechakaitika kare, saka ichokwadi, kwete kufungidzira.
n-k-k3-04.s.s2.explain: 아마 zvinoreva pamwe, -ㄹ 것 같아요 zvinoreva 'zvinoita sekuti', uye 아직 몰라요 zvinoreva 'handisati ndaziva'. Chirevo chenguva yakapfuura senge 다녀왔어요 chinozivisa chokwadi.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora nhau kuboka rechati repikiniki muchiKorea (mutauro une rukudzo): taura kuti 민수 ari kuuya, uye uratidze chinhu chimwe chichiri kungova kufungidzira.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mitsara miviri mipfupi: mumwe wezvakajeka, mumwe wezvisingajeki.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kuchikamu chisingajeki, shandisa izwi kana pendero rawakasangana naro mumameseji.
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura zvakajeka here kuti ari kuuya?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakachengeta chikamu che 'kunonoka zvishoma' sekufungidzira kwete sechokwadi here?
n-k-k3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Boka raizoziva kuti vanhu vangani vokuverenga here?

n-k-k3-05.title: 하준 anoreva ani ne '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.topic: Ndiani akataura chii: mhinduro inoenderana nemutsara wapfuura
n-k-k3-05.goal: Tsvaga kuti 'me too' pfupi muchati yeboka inoreva ani nei, sarudza kuti ndezvokwadi zvipi zvichishaikwa pachisarudzo cheboka, uye ukumbire chimwe chazvo.
n-k-k3-05.material:
Shamwari nhatu dziri kusarudza kudya kwemasikati muchati yeboka. 비빔밥 yechitoro kazhinji inouya nesosi inopisa yepepper tsvuku (고추장).

지아: 저는 비빔밥을 먹을래요.
하준: 저도 비빔밥이 좋아요.
서윤: 저는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
하준: 저도요.
n-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Ndiani akataura chii, uye mhinduro inoreva chii
n-k-k3-05.prereq.2: Unoziva 맵다 (kupisa) muchimiro che 매운 / 안 매워요
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chati. Mumutsara wekupedzisira, 하준 anoreva chii ne '저도요'?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga mutsara wakarurama pamusoro pe '저도요'. Ndicho chaanobvuma.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zvibvunze: 'zvakare' zvinoreva zvakafanana nani, uye nezvei?
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.a: '저도요' inopindura mutsara wakapfuura pakarepo. Mutsara iwoyo ndewa서윤, kwete wa지아.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.b: Anoda zvakare kudya kwemasikati ne 서윤.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.b: Mutsara wapfuura unotaura nezvechikafu, kwete kudya pamwe chete.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.c: 서윤 anongoti haagoni kudya chikafu chinopisa. 하준 ari kupindura mutsara iwoyo uye haataure chinhu pano nezve 비빔밥.
n-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: '-도' (zvakare) inobatanidza zvinotaurwa zvino nezvakangotaurwa. Mutsara pakarepo pamberi pewa하준 ndewa서윤: haagoni kudya chinopisa. Saka 하준 haagonizve. Mitsara miviri yapfuura akati anofarira 비빔밥, saka anofanira kunge achifunga kuti 비빔밥 inogona kunge isiri kupisa.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari dzese nhatu dzinogona kudya 비빔밥 pamwe chete here? Sarudza ZVESE zvichiri kudikanwa kuziva usati wapindura.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira rondedzero yezvakataurwa nemunhu mumwe nemumwe, uye uratidze zvichishaikwa pamumwe nemumwe.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bvisa zvokwadi zvingasachinje mhinduro, chero zvazvinoita.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.a: Kuti chitoro chinogona kugadzira 비빔밥 isina kupisa here
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.b: Kuti 하준 haagoni kudya chinopisa chaizvo here
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.b: Achangotaura izvozvo ne 저도요, saka unoziva kare.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.c: Kuti 지아 akadya 비빔밥 nezuro here
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.c: Zvakadyiwa na지아 nezuro hazvisarudze zvinogona kudyiwa nevatatu nhasi.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.o.d: Kuti 서윤 anoda kudya 비빔밥 kana isina kupisa here
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.r.e: 지아 anoda 비빔밥 chero zvazvaita; kuravira kwake kupisa hakumiriri vamwe kuidya.
n-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Zvinhu zviviri zvichiri zvakavhurika. Chikafu chinofanira kugoneka pasina kupisa, uye 서윤 akataura zvaasingagoni kudya chete, kwete zvaanoda. Zvimwe zvokwadi hazvichinji mhinduro.
